cases.question: What is the refund window?
cases.answer: Northwind accepts returns on most items within 30 days of delivery, counted from the date the carrier marks the parcel as delivered.
contexts: Northwind Supply Co. accepts returns on most items within 30 days of delivery. The 30-day window starts on the date the carrier marks the parcel as delivered, not the date the order was placed.
The 60-day Plus return window applies to orders placed while the membership was active.

cases.question: How much does Express delivery cost?
cases.answer: Express delivery costs $14.95 and arrives in 1 to 2 business days.
contexts:
| Standard | 3 to 5 business days | Free over $75, otherwise $6.95 |
| Express | 1 to 2 business days | $14.95 |
| Next Day | Next business day if ordered before 14:00 | $24.95 |

cases.question: How long after delivery do loyalty points appear?
cases.ground_truth: 14 days after delivery, so the return window has passed.
cases.answer: Loyalty points appear instantly at checkout and never expire.
contexts: Points post 14 days after delivery, not at purchase. The delay covers the return window, so points are not earned on items that come straight back.
Points expire after 24 months of account inactivity.
